criteria.reason: The source says operators normally open Deployment directly and gives their approval, Rae/Jo availability and staffed-channel prerequisites there. The control moves those prerequisites only to Tonight’s decision, before the intervening evidence section, while Deployment begins a numbered save/acquire/enable procedure without a cross-reference back to the prerequisites. A direct-entry operator can therefore follow the action sequence without seeing the required approval/staffing stop gate. This weakens the source’s independently usable operational entry point even though a reader starting at the top can recover every fact.
criteria.consequence: Required whole-artifact functional factor; length cannot offset failure.

Control C2 passes factual preservation but fails the stated direct-entry operational use.
